# Taseer — food image prompts

**Generated by `scripts/build-image-prompts.mjs` — do not edit by hand.**
Recipe and acceptance criteria: [specs/04-image-spec.md](specs/04-image-spec.md).

0 prompts — only the foods with no art yet. 2000 already painted are omitted; run with `--all` to include them.

Generate one category per session — style consistency holds best within a
batch. Save each result as `assets/food-images/<id>.png` at 1280×854, then run
`node scripts/build-images.py` (or `optimise-images.mjs`) to emit the 640×427
hero and 320×320 thumb. `node scripts/check-images.mjs` reports what is left.
